description: Probability of reaching a target price. Probability that the price closes beyond a target within 1, 7 and 30 days, and the approximate probability of touching it, from 14-day ATR volatility (normal approximation; touch ~ 2x close-beyond by the reflection principle). symbol must be one of the supported list (see list_symbols) and target must be a positive number, or the call returns 400 and is not charged; if volatility can't be computed from recent candles it returns 502 and is not charged. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

target.description: Target price in the quote currency
